description: Checks CodeWiki Decision meaning against fixed Project Server, Runtime, DSH, Broker Host, and Domain ownership.
requirement: The exact Decision Candidate must preserve Project Server as sole project authority; keep Runtime, DSH, Broker Host, Domain Plugins, Clients, Harnesses, and Checks within their admitted custody; and introduce no mutable self-loading or repository-local executable authority.

failure.message: Decision Candidate violates a fixed CodeWiki authority or custody boundary.
remediation: Correct proposed meaning before acceptance; do not defer an authority conflict to Planning or Implementation.
